SELECT PRODUCTION_ORDER_NO as PRODUCTION_ORDER_NO, ASSEMBLY_MATERIAL_NO as ASSEMBLY_MATERIAL_NO, MAIN_MATERIAL_DESC as MAIN_MATERIAL_DESC, SCHEDULED_DATE as SCHEDULED_DATE,
CASE WHEN kitting_status = '齐套' THEN '齐套' WHEN completable_sets >0 THEN '齐套' || completable_sets || '套' ELSE '不齐套' END as KITTING_STATUS,
PRODUCTION_WORKSHOP as PRODUCTION_WORKSHOP, SCHEDULED_QUANTITY as SCHEDULED_QUANTITY, COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO as COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO, COMPONENT_DESC as COMPONENT_DESC, UNIT_USAGE as UNIT_USAGE, required_qty as REQUIRED_QTY,
stock_tomorrow as STOCK_TOMORROW, stock_day_after_tomorrow as STOCK_DAY_AFTER_TOMORROW, stock_third_day as STOCK_THIRD_DAY,
stock_quantity as STOCK_QUANTITY, shortage_qty as SHORTAGE_QTY
FROM ( SELECT mp.PRODUCTION_ORDER_NO, mp.ASSEMBLY_MATERIAL_NO, mp.MAIN_MATERIAL_DESC, mp.SCHEDULED_DATE, mp.PRODUCTION_WORKSHOP, mp.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY, bom.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO, bom.COMPONENT_DESC, bom.UNIT_USAGE, (mp.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY * bom.UNIT_USAGE) as required_qty,
CASE WHEN mp.SCHEDULED_DATE = TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1 THEN LEAST((mp.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY * bom.UNIT_USAGE), stock.AVAILABLE_QUANTITY) ELSE 0 END as stock_tomorrow,
CASE WHEN mp.SCHEDULED_DATE = TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 2 THEN LEAST((mp.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY * bom.UNIT_USAGE), GREATEST(0, stock.AVAILABLE_QUANTITY - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mp2.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY * bom2.UNIT_USAGE), 0) FROM APS_MAIN_PLAN mp2 JOIN MATERIAL_BOM_IMPORT bom2 ON mp2.ASSEMBLY_MATERIAL_NO = bom2.MAIN_MATERIAL_NO WHERE mp2.SCHEDULED_DATE = TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1 AND bom2.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO = bom.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO AND mp2.DELETED = 0))) ELSE 0 END as stock_day_after_tomorrow,
CASE WHEN mp.SCHEDULED_DATE = TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 3 THEN LEAST((mp.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY * bom.UNIT_USAGE), GREATEST(0, stock.AVAILABLE_QUANTITY - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mp2.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY * bom2.UNIT_USAGE), 0) FROM APS_MAIN_PLAN mp2 JOIN MATERIAL_BOM_IMPORT bom2 ON mp2.ASSEMBLY_MATERIAL_NO = bom2.MAIN_MATERIAL_NO WHERE mp2.SCHEDULED_DATE IN (TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1, TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 2) AND bom2.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO = bom.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO AND mp2.DELETED = 0))) ELSE 0 END as stock_third_day,
CASE WHEN mp.SCHEDULED_DATE = TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1 THEN LEAST((mp.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY * bom.UNIT_USAGE), stock.AVAILABLE_QUANTITY) WHEN mp.SCHEDULED_DATE = TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 2 THEN LEAST((mp.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY * bom.UNIT_USAGE), GREATEST(0, stock.AVAILABLE_QUANTITY - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mp2.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY * bom2.UNIT_USAGE), 0) FROM APS_MAIN_PLAN mp2 JOIN MATERIAL_BOM_IMPORT bom2 ON mp2.ASSEMBLY_MATERIAL_NO = bom2.MAIN_MATERIAL_NO WHERE mp2.SCHEDULED_DATE = TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1 AND bom2.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO = bom.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO AND mp2.DELETED = 0))) WHEN mp.SCHEDULED_DATE = TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 3 THEN LEAST((mp.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY * bom.UNIT_USAGE), GREATEST(0, stock.AVAILABLE_QUANTITY - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mp2.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY * bom2.UNIT_USAGE), 0) FROM APS_MAIN_PLAN mp2 JOIN MATERIAL_BOM_IMPORT bom2 ON mp2.ASSEMBLY_MATERIAL_NO = bom2.MAIN_MATERIAL_NO WHERE mp2.SCHEDULED_DATE IN (TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1, TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 2) AND bom2.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO = bom.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO AND mp2.DELETED = 0))) ELSE 0 END as stock_quantity,
GREATEST(0, (mp.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY * bom.UNIT_USAGE) - CASE WHEN mp.SCHEDULED_DATE = TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1 THEN LEAST((mp.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY * bom.UNIT_USAGE), stock.AVAILABLE_QUANTITY) WHEN mp.SCHEDULED_DATE = TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 2 THEN LEAST((mp.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY * bom.UNIT_USAGE), GREATEST(0, stock.AVAILABLE_QUANTITY - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mp2.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY * bom2.UNIT_USAGE), 0) FROM APS_MAIN_PLAN mp2 JOIN MATERIAL_BOM_IMPORT bom2 ON mp2.ASSEMBLY_MATERIAL_NO = bom2.MAIN_MATERIAL_NO WHERE mp2.SCHEDULED_DATE = TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1 AND bom2.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO = bom.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO AND mp2.DELETED = 0))) WHEN mp.SCHEDULED_DATE = TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 3 THEN LEAST((mp.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY * bom.UNIT_USAGE), GREATEST(0, stock.AVAILABLE_QUANTITY - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mp2.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY * bom2.UNIT_USAGE), 0) FROM APS_MAIN_PLAN mp2 JOIN MATERIAL_BOM_IMPORT bom2 ON mp2.ASSEMBLY_MATERIAL_NO = bom2.MAIN_MATERIAL_NO WHERE mp2.SCHEDULED_DATE IN (TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1, TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 2) AND bom2.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO = bom.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO AND mp2.DELETED = 0))) ELSE 0 END) as shortage_qty,
CASE WHEN mp.SCHEDULED_DATE = TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1 THEN CASE WHEN (mp.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY * bom.UNIT_USAGE) <= stock.AVAILABLE_QUANTITY THEN '齐套' ELSE '不齐套' END WHEN mp.SCHEDULED_DATE = TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 2 THEN CASE WHEN (mp.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY * bom.UNIT_USAGE) <= GREATEST(0, stock.AVAILABLE_QUANTITY - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mp2.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY * bom2.UNIT_USAGE), 0) FROM APS_MAIN_PLAN mp2 JOIN MATERIAL_BOM_IMPORT bom2 ON mp2.ASSEMBLY_MATERIAL_NO = bom2.MAIN_MATERIAL_NO WHERE mp2.SCHEDULED_DATE = TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1 AND bom2.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO = bom.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO AND mp2.DELETED = 0)) THEN '齐套' ELSE '不齐套' END WHEN mp.SCHEDULED_DATE = TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 3 THEN CASE WHEN (mp.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY * bom.UNIT_USAGE) <= GREATEST(0, stock.AVAILABLE_QUANTITY - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mp2.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY * bom2.UNIT_USAGE), 0) FROM APS_MAIN_PLAN mp2 JOIN MATERIAL_BOM_IMPORT bom2 ON mp2.ASSEMBLY_MATERIAL_NO = bom2.MAIN_MATERIAL_NO WHERE mp2.SCHEDULED_DATE IN (TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1, TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 2) AND bom2.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO = bom.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO AND mp2.DELETED = 0)) THEN '齐套' ELSE '不齐套' END ELSE '不齐套' END as kitting_status,
CASE WHEN mp.SCHEDULED_DATE = TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1 THEN CASE WHEN (mp.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY * bom.UNIT_USAGE) <= stock.AVAILABLE_QUANTITY THEN mp.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY ELSE FLOOR(stock.AVAILABLE_QUANTITY / bom.UNIT_USAGE) END WHEN mp.SCHEDULED_DATE = TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 2 THEN CASE WHEN (mp.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY * bom.UNIT_USAGE) <= GREATEST(0, stock.AVAILABLE_QUANTITY - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mp2.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY * bom2.UNIT_USAGE), 0) FROM APS_MAIN_PLAN mp2 JOIN MATERIAL_BOM_IMPORT bom2 ON mp2.ASSEMBLY_MATERIAL_NO = bom2.MAIN_MATERIAL_NO WHERE mp2.SCHEDULED_DATE = TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1 AND bom2.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO = bom.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO AND mp2.DELETED = 0)) THEN mp.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY ELSE FLOOR(GREATEST(0, stock.AVAILABLE_QUANTITY - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mp2.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY * bom2.UNIT_USAGE), 0) FROM APS_MAIN_PLAN mp2 JOIN MATERIAL_BOM_IMPORT bom2 ON mp2.ASSEMBLY_MATERIAL_NO = bom2.MAIN_MATERIAL_NO WHERE mp2.SCHEDULED_DATE = TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1 AND bom2.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO = bom.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO AND mp2.DELETED = 0)) / bom.UNIT_USAGE) END WHEN mp.SCHEDULED_DATE = TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 3 THEN CASE WHEN (mp.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY * bom.UNIT_USAGE) <= GREATEST(0, stock.AVAILABLE_QUANTITY - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mp2.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY * bom2.UNIT_USAGE), 0) FROM APS_MAIN_PLAN mp2 JOIN MATERIAL_BOM_IMPORT bom2 ON mp2.ASSEMBLY_MATERIAL_NO = bom2.MAIN_MATERIAL_NO WHERE mp2.SCHEDULED_DATE IN (TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1, TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 2) AND bom2.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO = bom.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO AND mp2.DELETED = 0)) THEN mp.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY ELSE FLOOR(GREATEST(0, stock.AVAILABLE_QUANTITY - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mp2.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY * bom2.UNIT_USAGE), 0) FROM APS_MAIN_PLAN mp2 JOIN MATERIAL_BOM_IMPORT bom2 ON mp2.ASSEMBLY_MATERIAL_NO = bom2.MAIN_MATERIAL_NO WHERE mp2.SCHEDULED_DATE IN (TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1, TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 2) AND bom2.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO = bom.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO AND mp2.DELETED = 0)) / bom.UNIT_USAGE) END ELSE 0 END as completable_sets
FROM APS_MAIN_PLAN mp JOIN MATERIAL_BOM_IMPORT bom ON mp.ASSEMBLY_MATERIAL_NO = bom.MAIN_MATERIAL_NO LEFT JOIN REAL_TIME_STOCK stock ON bom.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO = stock.MATERIAL_NO WHERE mp.DELETED = 0 AND bom.DELETED = 0 AND mp.SCHEDULED_DATE BETWEEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1 AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 3 AND (stock.DELETED = 0 OR stock.DELETED IS NULL) ) ORDER BY SCHEDULED_DATE, PRODUCTION_ORDER_NO, COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO

SELECT f.*, CASE WHEN a.min_completable_sets >= f.REQUIRED_QTY / f.UNIT_USAGE THEN '齐套' WHEN a.min_completable_sets > 0 THEN '齐套' || a.min_completable_sets || '套' ELSE '不齐套' END as ASSEMBLY_KITTING_STATUS, CASE when a.OPEN_FLAG = 0 then '未全部出库' ELSE '已全部出库' END AS OPEN_FLAG FROM ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT PRODUCTION_ORDER_NO as PRODUCTION_ORDER_NO, ASSEMBLY_MATERIAL_NO as ASSEMBLY_MATERIAL_NO, MAIN_MATERIAL_DESC as MAIN_MATERIAL_DESC, SCHEDULED_DATE as SCHEDULED_DATE,
CASE WHEN (stock_tomorrow + stock_day_after_tomorrow + stock_third_day + OPEN_QUANTITY) >= required_qty THEN '齐套' WHEN (stock_tomorrow + stock_day_after_tomorrow + stock_third_day + OPEN_QUANTITY) > 0 THEN '齐套' || FLOOR((stock_tomorrow + stock_day_after_tomorrow + stock_third_day + OPEN_QUANTITY) / UNIT_USAGE) || '套' ELSE '不齐套' END as KITTING_STATUS,
PRODUCTION_WORKSHOP as PRODUCTION_WORKSHOP, SCHEDULED_QUANTITY as SCHEDULED_QUANTITY, COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO as COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO, COMPONENT_DESC as COMPONENT_DESC, NVL(UNIT_USAGE,0) as UNIT_USAGE, NVL(required_qty,0) as REQUIRED_QTY,
stock_tomorrow as STOCK_TOMORROW, stock_day_after_tomorrow as STOCK_DAY_AFTER_TOMORROW, stock_third_day as STOCK_THIRD_DAY,
(stock_tomorrow + stock_day_after_tomorrow + stock_third_day) as STOCK_QUANTITY,
GREATEST(0, required_qty - (stock_tomorrow + stock_day_after_tomorrow + stock_third_day + OPEN_QUANTITY)) as SHORTAGE_QTY, open_quantity, outbound_qty, CASE WHEN (stock_tomorrow + stock_day_after_tomorrow + stock_third_day + OPEN_QUANTITY) >= required_qty THEN SCHEDULED_QUANTITY WHEN (stock_tomorrow + stock_day_after_tomorrow + stock_third_day + OPEN_QUANTITY) > 0 THEN FLOOR((stock_tomorrow + stock_day_after_tomorrow + stock_third_day + OPEN_QUANTITY) / UNIT_USAGE) ELSE 0 END as COMPLETABLE_SETS FROM ( SELECT mp.PRODUCTION_ORDER_NO, mp.ASSEMBLY_MATERIAL_NO, mp.MAIN_MATERIAL_DESC, mp.SCHEDULED_DATE, mp.PRODUCTION_WORKSHOP, mp.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY, bom.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO, bom.COMPONENT_DESC, bom.UNIT_USAGE, (mp.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY * bom.UNIT_USAGE) as required_qty, COALESCE(stock.AVAILABLE_QUANTITY, 0) as total_available_stock, COALESCE(TRACE.OPEN_QUANTITY,0) AS OPEN_QUANTITY, COALESCE(task.outbound_qty,0) AS outbound_qty, CASE WHEN mp.SCHEDULED_DATE = TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1 THEN LEAST( (mp.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY * bom.UNIT_USAGE), GREATEST(0, LEAST(COALESCE(stock.AVAILABLE_QUANTITY, 0) - NVL(COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(LEAST(mp2.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY * bom2.UNIT_USAGE - COALESCE(TRACE2.OPEN_QUANTITY, 0), GREATEST(0, LEAST(COALESCE(stock2.AVAILABLE_QUANTITY, 0)
- COALESCE(( SELECT SUM( LEAST(COALESCE(mp3.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY * bom3.UNIT_USAGE,0) - COALESCE(TRACE3.OPEN_QUANTITY, 0), GREATEST(0, COALESCE(stock3.AVAILABLE_QUANTITY, 0) - COALESCE(TRACE3.OPEN_QUANTITY, 0) ) ) ) FROM APS_MAIN_PLAN mp3 JOIN ( SELECT A.MAIN_MATERIAL_NO, A.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO, A.COMPONENT_DESC, SUM(UNIT_USAGE) as UNIT_USAGE FROM MATERIAL_BOM_IMPORT A LEFT JOIN MATERIAL_MASTER_IMPORT B ON A.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO = B.MATERIAL_NO WHERE A.DELETED = 0 AND NVL(B.EXTERNAL_PROCUREMENT_STORAGE,0) != '6403' AND NVL(B.EXTERNAL_PROCUREMENT_STORAGE,0) != '6414' AND NVL(B.EXTERNAL_PROCUREMENT_STORAGE,0) != '6405' AND A.LEVEL_NO = 1 GROUP BY MAIN_MATERIAL_NO, COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO, COMPONENT_DESC ) bom3 ON mp3.ASSEMBLY_MATERIAL_NO = bom3.MAIN_MATERIAL_NO LEFT JOIN (SELECT MATERIAL_NO, SUM(AVAILABLE_QUANTITY) AS AVAILABLE_QUANTITY FROM REAL_TIME_STOCK WHERE DELETED = 0 OR DELETED IS NULL GROUP BY MATERIAL_NO) stock3 ON bom3.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO = stock3.MATERIAL_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ORDER_NO, MATERIAL_NO, SUM(OUTBOUND_ACCUMULATED) as OPEN_QUANTITY FROM TRACE_ORDER_DEMAND WHERE DELETED = 0 GROUP BY ORDER_NO, MATERIAL_NO ) TRACE3 ON TRACE3.ORDER_NO = mp3.PRODUCTION_ORDER_NO AND TRACE3.MATERIAL_NO = bom3.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO WHERE mp3.DELETED = 0 AND bom3.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO = bom2.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO AND mp3.SCHEDULED_DATE = TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1 AND (mp3.PRODUCTION_ORDER_NO < mp2.PRODUCTION_ORDER_NO OR (mp3.PRODUCTION_ORDER_NO = mp2.PRODUCTION_ORDER_NO AND mp3.ASSEMBLY_MATERIAL_NO < mp2.ASSEMBLY_MATERIAL_NO)) ), 0), COALESCE(mp2.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY * bom2.UNIT_USAGE - COALESCE(TRACE2.OPEN_QUANTITY, 0), 0)) ))) FROM APS_MAIN_PLAN mp2 JOIN ( SELECT A.MAIN_MATERIAL_NO, A.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO, A.COMPONENT_DESC, SUM(UNIT_USAGE) as UNIT_USAGE FROM MATERIAL_BOM_IMPORT A LEFT JOIN MATERIAL_MASTER_IMPORT B ON A.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO = B.MATERIAL_NO WHERE A.DELETED = 0 AND NVL(B.EXTERNAL_PROCUREMENT_STORAGE,0) != '6403' AND NVL(B.EXTERNAL_PROCUREMENT_STORAGE,0) != '6414' AND NVL(B.EXTERNAL_PROCUREMENT_STORAGE,0) != '6405' AND A.LEVEL_NO = 1 GROUP BY MAIN_MATERIAL_NO, COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO, COMPONENT_DESC ) bom2 ON mp2.ASSEMBLY_MATERIAL_NO = bom2.MAIN_MATERIAL_NO LEFT JOIN (SELECT MATERIAL_NO, SUM(AVAILABLE_QUANTITY) AS AVAILABLE_QUANTITY FROM REAL_TIME_STOCK WHERE DELETED = 0 OR DELETED IS NULL GROUP BY MATERIAL_NO) stock2 ON bom2.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO = stock2.MATERIAL_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ORDER_NO, MATERIAL_NO, SUM(OUTBOUND_ACCUMULATED) as OPEN_QUANTITY FROM TRACE_ORDER_DEMAND WHERE DELETED = 0 GROUP BY ORDER_NO, MATERIAL_NO ) TRACE2 ON TRACE2.ORDER_NO = mp2.PRODUCTION_ORDER_NO AND TRACE2.MATERIAL_NO = bom2.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO WHERE mp2.DELETED = 0 AND bom2.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO = bom.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO AND mp2.SCHEDULED_DATE = TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1 AND (mp2.PRODUCTION_ORDER_NO < mp.PRODUCTION_ORDER_NO OR (mp2.PRODUCTION_ORDER_NO = mp.PRODUCTION_ORDER_NO AND mp2.ASSEMBLY_MATERIAL_NO < mp.ASSEMBLY_MATERIAL_NO)) ), 0),0),COALESCE(mp.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY * bom.UNIT_USAGE - COALESCE(TRACE.OPEN_QUANTITY,0), 0)) ) ) ELSE 0 END as stock_tomorrow,
CASE WHEN mp.SCHEDULED_DATE = TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 2 THEN LEAST( (mp.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY * bom.UNIT_USAGE) - COALESCE(TRACE.OPEN_QUANTITY, 0), GREATEST(0, LEAST(COALESCE(stock.AVAILABLE_QUANTITY, 0) - LEAST(COALESCE(( SELECT SUM( LEAST(COALESCE(mp2.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY * bom2.UNIT_USAGE,0) - COALESCE(TRACE2.OPEN_QUANTITY, 0), GREATEST(0, COALESCE(stock2.AVAILABLE_QUANTITY, 0) - COALESCE(TRACE2.OPEN_QUANTITY, 0) ) ) ) FROM APS_MAIN_PLAN mp2 JOIN (SELECT A.MAIN_MATERIAL_NO, A.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO, A.COMPONENT_DESC, SUM(UNIT_USAGE) as UNIT_USAGE FROM MATERIAL_BOM_IMPORT A LEFT JOIN MATERIAL_MASTER_IMPORT B ON A.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO = B.MATERIAL_NO WHERE A.DELETED = 0 AND NVL(B.EXTERNAL_PROCUREMENT_STORAGE,0) != '6403' AND NVL(B.EXTERNAL_PROCUREMENT_STORAGE,0) != '6414' AND NVL(B.EXTERNAL_PROCUREMENT_STORAGE,0) != '6405' AND A.LEVEL_NO = 1 GROUP BY MAIN_MATERIAL_NO, COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO, COMPONENT_DESC) bom2 ON mp2.ASSEMBLY_MATERIAL_NO = bom2.MAIN_MATERIAL_NO LEFT JOIN (SELECT MATERIAL_NO, SUM(AVAILABLE_QUANTITY) AS AVAILABLE_QUANTITY FROM REAL_TIME_STOCK WHERE DELETED = 0 OR DELETED IS NULL GROUP BY MATERIAL_NO) stock2 ON bom2.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO = stock2.MATERIAL_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ORDER_NO, MATERIAL_NO, SUM(OUTBOUND_ACCUMULATED) as OPEN_QUANTITY FROM TRACE_ORDER_DEMAND WHERE DELETED = 0 GROUP BY ORDER_NO, MATERIAL_NO ) TRACE2 ON TRACE2.ORDER_NO = mp2.PRODUCTION_ORDER_NO AND TRACE2.MATERIAL_NO = bom2.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO WHERE mp2.DELETED = 0 AND bom2.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO = bom.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO AND mp2.SCHEDULED_DATE = TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1 ),0),COALESCE(stock.AVAILABLE_QUANTITY,0)) - NVL(COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(LEAST(mp2.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY * bom2.UNIT_USAGE - COALESCE(TRACE2.OPEN_QUANTITY, 0), GREATEST(0, LEAST(COALESCE(stock2.AVAILABLE_QUANTITY, 0)
- COALESCE(( SELECT SUM( LEAST(COALESCE(mp3.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY * bom3.UNIT_USAGE,0) - COALESCE(TRACE3.OPEN_QUANTITY, 0), GREATEST(0, COALESCE(stock3.AVAILABLE_QUANTITY, 0) - COALESCE(TRACE3.OPEN_QUANTITY, 0) ) ) ) FROM APS_MAIN_PLAN mp3 JOIN ( SELECT A.MAIN_MATERIAL_NO, A.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO, A.COMPONENT_DESC, SUM(UNIT_USAGE) as UNIT_USAGE FROM MATERIAL_BOM_IMPORT A LEFT JOIN MATERIAL_MASTER_IMPORT B ON A.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO = B.MATERIAL_NO WHERE A.DELETED = 0 AND NVL(B.EXTERNAL_PROCUREMENT_STORAGE,0) != '6403' AND NVL(B.EXTERNAL_PROCUREMENT_STORAGE,0) != '6414' AND NVL(B.EXTERNAL_PROCUREMENT_STORAGE,0) != '6405' AND A.LEVEL_NO = 1 GROUP BY MAIN_MATERIAL_NO, COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO, COMPONENT_DESC ) bom3 ON mp3.ASSEMBLY_MATERIAL_NO = bom3.MAIN_MATERIAL_NO LEFT JOIN (SELECT MATERIAL_NO, SUM(AVAILABLE_QUANTITY) AS AVAILABLE_QUANTITY FROM REAL_TIME_STOCK WHERE DELETED = 0 OR DELETED IS NULL GROUP BY MATERIAL_NO) stock3 ON bom3.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO = stock3.MATERIAL_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ORDER_NO, MATERIAL_NO, SUM(OUTBOUND_ACCUMULATED) as OPEN_QUANTITY FROM TRACE_ORDER_DEMAND WHERE DELETED = 0 GROUP BY ORDER_NO, MATERIAL_NO ) TRACE3 ON TRACE3.ORDER_NO = mp3.PRODUCTION_ORDER_NO AND TRACE3.MATERIAL_NO = bom3.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO WHERE mp3.DELETED = 0 AND bom3.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO = bom2.COMPONENT_MATERIAL_NO AND mp3.SCHEDULED_DATE = TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 2 AND (mp3.PRODUCTION_ORDER_NO < mp2.PRODUCTION_ORDER_NO OR (mp3.PRODUCTION_ORDER_NO = mp2.PRODUCTION_ORDER_NO AND mp3.ASSEMBLY_MATERIAL_NO < mp2.ASSEMBLY_MATERIAL_NO)) ), 0), COALESCE(mp2.SCHEDULED_QUANTITY * bom2.UNIT_USAGE -
